name: Thread the Needle

instructions.description: Begin on all fours with a neutral spine.
Slide one arm under the opposite arm and lower that shoulder and side of the head toward the floor.
Keep the hips mostly stacked over the knees while you feel a gentle rotation through the upper back.
Press into the supporting hand to return, then repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Hold briefly on each side or move slowly in and out.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Rotate from a side-lying position for a more supported thoracic stretch.

commentsNotes: Do not force the neck into rotation.
Keep the movement comfortable in the shoulder.
